title: DeepEdu-v1: Efficient and Scalable Agentic LLMs for Vietnamese Education
selection_reason: Though evaluated in an education application, the abstract explicitly presents a reusable long-context LLM inference engine that reduces retrieval calls, cuts prefill latency about 35%, and nearly doubles TTFT speed over standard vLLM. The concrete inference-system contribution supports inclusion.
